sourceRefs.locator: No. 12, opening: second year of Childeric, Pippin as dux et princeps, city of Soissons, bishops, clergy, counts and magnates.
Entries 749 and 750: petition to Zacharias, elevation at Soissons, Boniface and the tonsure of Childeric. Entries 753–754: papal visit, anointing of Pippin and both sons.
